```python
def flop_count_str(flops: FlopCountAnalysis, activations: Optional[
    ActivationCountAnalysis]=None) ->str:
    model = flops._model
    params = dict(parameter_count(model))

    flops.unsupported_ops_warnings(False)
    flops.uncalled_modules_warnings(False)
    flops.tracer_warnings("none")

    stats = {"#params": params, "#flops": flops.by_module()}
    stat_columns = ["#params", "#flops"]

    if activations is not None:
        activations.unsupported_ops_warnings(False)
        activations.uncalled_modules_warnings(False)
        activations.tracer_warnings("none")
        stats["#acts"] = activations.by_module()
        stat_columns += ["#acts"]

    stats = _group_by_module(stats)
    stats = _fill_missing_statistics(model, stats)
    stats = _pretty_statistics(stats, hide_zero=False)
    stats = _indicate_uncalled_modules(
        stats,
        "#flops",
        flops.uncalled_modules(),
        uncalled_indicator="N/A",
    )
    if activations is not None:
        stats = _indicate_uncalled_modules(
            stats,
            "#acts",
            activations.uncalled_modules(),
            uncalled_indicator="N/A",
        )

    # Reorder stats to match stat_columns order
    ordered_stats = {}
    for mod, mod_stats in stats.items():
        ordered_stats[mod] = {col: mod_stats[col] for col in stat_columns if col in mod_stats}

    model_str = _model_stats_str(model, ordered_stats)

    # Add input sizes
    input_sizes = _get_input_sizes(flops._inputs)
    input_str = "Input sizes (torch.Tensor only): {}\n".format(input_sizes)

    # Check if there are any N/A values
    has_na = any(
        "N/A" in mod_stats.values()
        for mod_stats in ordered_stats.values()
    )

    output = model_str + "\n" + input_str
    if has_na:
        output += "N/A indicates a possibly missing statistic due to how the module was called.\n"

    return output
```
